findings.quote: Among the operations in the county that dry grain for money, the mixed-flow has a fixed reputation: the tall machine with the ducts inside is the one that burns.
findings.note: ROUND-1 MAJOR #1 VERIFIED REPAIRED, residue recorded at minor. The 'Ask X …, and the answer comes back' skeleton is gone from the unit; a bank-wide sweep of every ELF opening sentence (batches 1-19, 44 units) confirms the family now runs elf-b8-004, elf-b9-001, elf-b13-004 and elf-b16-002 only, and this unit is no longer its fifth member. The replacement carries no verbatim bank string ('fixed reputation' occurs once in the bank, here). It does still sit in the bank's larger received-view-stated-then-overturned lede family, whose closest members are elf-b5-001 'For years the pitch to any glassmaker has run the same way: …' and elf-b8-001 'For as long as anyone at the leases can remember, the rule of a fine pearl has been a simple one: …' - same fronted scope adverbial, same stative NP naming the trade's settled view, same colon gloss. DISPOSITION: within tolerance. Those two are eleven and fourteen batches back, neither is in this lane's recent run (elf-b16-001, elf-b17-001 and elf-b18-001 all open on scene or on a flat corrective assertion), and the move is HP-attested as an expository opening - host-2021-verb2-ELF-040 opens by fixing the received frame ('Twenty-seven B.C. was an important year for Rome') before unsettling it across the piece. Charging a generic family at this distance would be over-fitting.

findings.quote: The explanation is as settled as the count.
findings.note: New byte, note only, no defect: the repaired lede's 'fixed reputation' and this sentence's 'as settled as' both gloss the received view within three sentences of each other, where the pre-repair lede carried the emphasis in a verb ('the answer comes back at once'). Read against host-2021-verb2-ELF-040, which restates its received frame repeatedly ('There is some confusion over …', 'has long confounded scholars', 'much debate'), the doubling is inside the exemplar's own tolerance for signposting a settled view. Recorded so the repair's collateral wording is auditable, not charged.

findings.quote: The first thing he found was dirt.
findings.note: Carried unchanged from round 1. DISPOSITION: within tolerance at minor; the concrete residue that offsets it survives the repair intact (the February buckets, the run-on-the-fan remedy, the two-in-the-morning coda), and the repair round did not add scaffolding. Question style is squarely HP: 'What is this text mainly about?', 'What are we told about …?', 'What is implied about …?', 'What is the writer’s attitude toward …?' are all corpus-attested ELF stem forms.

findings.quote: “What I will defend is the timing,” he says. “Why mixed-flow machines dominate the count is a softer argument, and I think it is about who buys them rather than what is inside them.”

Recommend the next batch brief forbid the two long lanes from sharing an adjudication shape in the same batch.

findings.quote: – Lettice Thrusselby
findings.note: ROUND-1 MAJOR VERIFIED REPAIRED; binding batch18 disposition now DISCHARGED. That disposition read 'the streak is now three and the next cloze must break the construction (bare byline or a different credential syntax)'; the unit takes the first of the two named remedies. The credential frame is gone in full - no 'writes', no topic PP, no periodical - breaking the exact three-unit run elf-b16-002 '– Kester Orrenshaw, from a monthly column on English towns', elf-b17-002 '– Georgina Chalkwright writes about civic life for a regional weekly.', elf-b18-002 '– Prudence Dabbershaw writes a column on working life for a monthly magazine.'. A byline sweep over all 21 shipped ELF units confirms the bare form is the bank's dominant one (14 of 21) and the settled form of both the ELF-long lane (elf-b14-001, elf-b17-001, elf-b18-001) and the TYPE-002 lane (elf-b15-004 through elf-b18-004), so the cloze lane has moved onto the bank's majority form rather than onto a new one. DISPOSITION: discharged, no carry-forward. Note only: three of batch19's four ELF units now carry a bare byline and elf-b19-003 is the sole credentialled one - the inverse of batch18's distribution, and inside range.

findings.quote: the tone of that line is not approving, but it is not ___(4)___ either
findings.note: Carried unchanged from round 1. Second consecutive cloze whose polarity gap is the tone of an institutional written instrument - elf-b18-002's gap 2 runs 'beneath the sponge the message is ___' on the laminated notice above the taps - and the two units share their argumentative frame: a written instrument that fails to govern conduct around a shared resource, with the passage closing on the instrument's inertness. The fleet repair touched the sentence AFTER gap 2 ('That is the clause as written, and nobody disputes it or finds it odd'), which sharpens the letter-of-the-rule reading and, if anything, deepens the written-instrument frame. DISPOSITION: within tolerance at minor, carried forward - b18-002 resolves on temperament and this one declines to resolve at all, and the passage's genre and temperature are magazine-grade throughout (the twelve-years-from-a-key arithmetic, the concrete path laid in the seventies, the plum tree planted too near the boundary), well clear of the cloze scope rule's listicle failure mode. Recommend the next cloze brief exclude the written-instrument frame outright.

findings.quote: A pot is bedded in a fillet of mortar, so a sweep could try a taller one without calling a bricklayer.
findings.note: Carried unchanged from round 1. Batch18's disposition asked the next TYPE-001 short to leave the mortar/damp domain. Damp is left - the mechanism here is draught, not water - but this is the third domestic building-envelope masonry short in four (elf-b16-003 open joints above a window head, elf-b18-003 torching mortar under tiles, this pot bedded in mortar) and mortar is again the load-bearing practical detail in the closing sentence. DISPOSITION: half honoured, half not, unchanged from round 1; recommend batch20's TYPE-001 leave masonry entirely rather than leave one hazard within it. Register itself is sound: the passage reads as trade writing with a diagnostic payload, which is the register of the short ELF exemplars (host-ver2-2019-verb1-ELF-031, var-2022-1-verb1-ELF-031 both run compressed expository prose with one inference to make).

findings.quote: Builders’ yards sold whatever was in stock
findings.note: New byte, note only, no defect. fleet-repair-1 gave the bare 'Yards' its head noun and, in the same round, unified the passage's referent on 'pot' by dropping the trade variant 'can' from the one diagnostic sentence. Both edits were G-ENG-driven; their register side effect is a passage marginally less trade-inflected and marginally more uniform in vocabulary. Weighed and not charged: 'builders’ yards', 'a course above its neighbours', 'a sweep' and 'a fillet of mortar' keep the trade texture that matters, and the removed variant would have put a second name for the key's own referent in front of the solver. The imperative lede 'Stand across the road from a terrace and count the pots along one stack' is unchanged and carries round 1's intra-batch mood note (two second-person ELF ledes in batch19), which the elf-b19-001 lede repair does not touch since the 'Ask' construction was replaced rather than re-imperativised.

The REGISTER finding itself stands unchanged on current bytes: this is the third TYPE-002 short in five to close on what the record failed to say (elf-b15-004 'Bardsell’s report … does not mention the summer.', elf-b18-004 'The wardens’ minutes record the new lettings without a word of explanation.'), beside las-b18-003's coda. findings.quote: Sedan 2016 har han låtit resa nio ugnar av Gnistarpstyp intill de utgrävda ugnsplatserna och blåsa dem under kontrollerade former, sammanlagt trettiosex gånger.
findings.note: OWNER-LEVEL LANE-CLONE FINDING, re-judged and STRENGTHENED on current bytes; recorded for disposition, NOT proposed as a kill. Independent count over every LAS long unit in the bank: rural Swedish heat/fire-craft topics now occupy four of the last six long slots - las-b14-001 (kolmilor och tjardalar), las-b16-001 (tegelbruk), las-b18-001 (kalkugnar), las-b19-001 (blastugnar) - with only las-b15-001 (garveri) and las-b17-001 (tandsticksfabrik) breaking the run, and the last two are back-to-back and both literally ugn-centred (ugn* token counts: b16-001 5, b18-001 19, b19-001 15; every other LAS long in the bank scores 0). Against las-b18-001 the unit repeats the lane move for move: a low stone/clay ugn described dimensionally, a named socken (Klyvinge / Gnistarps socken), a work rhythm set by frost and firewood, a named researcher who has surveyed the furnace remains in the landscape (Torun Gillervall's seventy ugnsrester / the fjorton platser matts in i socknen), an experimental reconstruction raised beside those surveyed sites (the lansmuseum's rebuilt kiln to be fired next summer / Tolvsater's nine kilns blown thirty-six times), remains read as low overgrown mounds with a hollow, a three-to-four-term craft glossary, and a coda dating the practice. Both titles are built on the furnace itself. This is NOT a register defect - the piece reads as a real Swedish facktext and holds the exemplars' intellectual temperature (a named investigator's measurements conceded and her interpretation refuted is exactly host-2020-verb2-LAS-020's argumentative posture) - it is a bank-diversity defect that is student-visible across a study session. DISPOSITION PROPOSED (owner call, three options): (a) SHIP AS IS and bind batch20's LAS long brief to exclude every furnace/kiln/combustion craft and every experimental-reconstruction frame, which is the cheapest option and the one consistent with the b18 precedent; (b) SHIP WITH SEQUENCING CONSTRAINT - ship the unit but require the assembly step never to place las-b18-001 and las-b19-001 in the same provpass or the same adaptive session; (c) REGENERATE the lane on a non-craft LAS long topic, which is the only option that actually reduces the four-in-six concentration but costs a full generation and gate cycle. Recommendation: (a) plus (b); the unit's own content (the fast-versus-slow blowing result, the iron-rich slag as a precondition rather than a failure) is genuinely new and does not duplicate b18-001's payload.

findings.quote: Ledingsbo telefonförening gav ut elva kataloger mellan 1907 och 1931.

Toponym texture: 'Ledingsbo' enters on the '-bo' tail beside the registry's Vrantebo (a batch16 rename forced by the Skarpbo real-place collision); 6 edits apart, unrelated onsets, and '-bo' is among the most productive Swedish settlement suffixes. The unit's own log records the rejection of Snarhult, Ormsater and Nyhamre on one-letter/exact real-place grounds, which is the Rossmala discipline applied correctly. Genre and temperature are sound against the LAS exemplars - a first-person investigator who states three hypotheses, kills all three on the documents, and leaves three residuals unresolved is the intellectual posture of var-2019-verb1-LAS-018, not a school-essay exposition.
